quote: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself — and you are the easiest person to fool.
author: Richard Feynman

quote: I recommend to you to take care of the minutes; for hours will take care of themselves.
author: Lord Chesterfield

quote: Don’t practice until you get it right. Practice until you can’t get it wrong.
author: Anonymous

quote: Struggling to retrieve information primes the brain for subsequent learning, even when the retrieval itself is unsuccessful.
author: David Epstein

quote: Science is built up of facts, as a house is built of stones; but an accumulation of facts is no more a science than a heap of stones is a house.
author: Henri Poincaré

quote: You can sit in this very chair and find something that has existed throughout all of eternity and be the first person to explore it.
author: John Conway
